title: Life Orchestration
hook: Every part of my life works fine on its own. Put together, it's a mess.
statement: The parts of your life need to work together, not just work.
explainer: Your business, home, health, and money all share the same 24 hours. When one system fights another, you spend your days putting out fires instead of building.
sop: List the big systems running your life: business, home, health, relationships, money.
Score System Alignment and Flow from 1 to 10.
Find the one system causing friction for the others. Usually the loudest one.
Fix one specific friction point this week, like a clashing schedule.
Review the whole picture monthly, not just whatever's on fire.
equation_example: System Alignment 7, Flow 6. 7 × 6 = 42. Higher means your systems back each other up and life feels coordinated. Lower means you're constantly refereeing parts that should be on the same team.
question: Name the one area of your life that's out of sync with everything else right now.
closing_statement: Tune the whole band, not just the loudest player.
